noob.desain: (young American teenage boy gamer, about seventeen, casual natural voice, relaxed and a little sarcastic)
noob.ref_teks: Man, this hotel is so quiet tonight. Nobody is in the lobby, and my room is all the way at the top.

max.desain: (American teenage boy, about sixteen, energetic, cocky and funny, slightly raspy voice)
max.ref_teks: Dude, trust me, this is going to be the best video ever. We just sneak in, film the rides, and get out.

park.desain: (cheerful American female theme park announcer, bright, bubbly and friendly)
park.ref_teks: Good morning, everyone, and welcome to the happiest park in the world! Please keep your hands inside the ride at all times.

hoppy.desain: (deep warm cartoon mascot voice, slow and friendly, like a giant bunny character for kids)
hoppy.ref_teks: Hello there, my little friends! It's me, your best buddy. Are you ready to have some fun today?
